race.title: Debra Corner Happy Birthday Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Plenty of pace on paper. It could be worth taking a chance on JET NOIR , who's bred to stay well and begins life in handicaps on a lowly mark. Lady Phoebe and After Many Days also need considering in a wide-open race. JET NOIR (IRE) LADY PHOEBE (IRE) AFTER MANY DAYS
race.bettingForecast: Crafty Gael (3/1), Lady Phoebe (7/2), Robert d'Ores (9/2), The Clonmel Kid (13/2), After Many Days (8/1), De Deli Counter (12/1), Ol Parson (14/1), Masterminding (20/1), Dillarchie (20/1), Getaway Master (20/1), Jet Noir (25/1)
